extraction.Name: Mrs. Emma Fog
extraction.Refused/Protested: she asked for patent in fee for 320 acres or one-half of her allotment and did not want patent in fee for all of her allotment, but that a patent in fee for all her allotment was mailed to her and receipt for same signed by her and mailed back to the Pine Ridge Agency office
extraction.Recorded patent: patent in fee was filed, at Kadoka, South Dakota, by Fred Limbard, Chamberlain, S. D., who purchased her land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: her allotment was not mortgaged but that the whole 640 acres was sold to Fred Limbard, now deceased, who lived at Chamberlain, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: Fred Limbard, Chamberlain, S. D., now deceased; she received $3000.00 cash and there was an understanding that she was to receive $3000.00 more or have 320 acres of the land deeded back to her, but that Mr. Limbard went to California and died before he gave her the second $3000.00 or gave her back 320 acres
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, Frank Fog
extraction.NOTES: Physical condition is poor; does not own any land or property at this time; has two minor children; allotment was 640 acres total; patent receipt signed and mailed back to Pine Ridge Agency office | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
